short_original_summary: Select and interpret information, ideas and perspectives across varied reading.
Explain how language choices and text organisation shape a writer’s effects.
Compare connections between writers’ viewpoints and how each conveys them.
Shape effective and imaginative writing to suit audience, purpose, form, tone and register.
Control vocabulary, sentences, paragraphs and language accuracy to communicate clearly.
Present formally, respond to questions and feedback, and use spoken Standard English effectively.
